listing.name: Voices of the Void
listing.summary: Adds ships and portraits from the game Voices of the Void.
listing.aiSummary: Adds ships and portraits from the game Voices of the Void.

description:
This is a mod featuring ships and portraits from the namesake game

Voices of the Void

Note: You will need the mod Console Commands to spawn in the ship.

Download link:

Github direct download

Repository link if you only want to browse

The Ship is based on the Warparrow from the game, using its description in the wiki. Art was made in Gimp referencing the ingame model.

Spoiler[close]

Source for Portraits and Flags in the mod:

Portraits -

Dr.Kel

Argemia Armuntela

Flags -

In Shrimp We Trust

Into The Void

Permission to use wiki pictures

Spoiler[close]
